correctness.rationale: The projective toric hexagon has six affine A2 vertex charts permuted transitively by S3. An explicit integral six-by-six Hasse matrix has identically zero determinant. Independent exact integer Leibniz expansion of every one of its 36 size-five minors gives 18 nonzero monomials and the ideal \((2u^2,uv,2v^2)\), with explicit generating minors -2u^2,-uv,-2v^2. Base change gives \((u,v)^2\) for all char !=2, and \((uv)\) for char2. Matrix ranks at toric vertex, open boundary and torus are 3,4,5 as stated, with 4 only appearing in char2. Toric gluing gives 6 fat points of length3 or a reduced hexagonal cycle of six lines; Hilbert-polynomial computations follow from these exact schemes. An executed stdlib-only checker regenerates the entire minor computation from binomial definitions. The computation and geometric gluing together prove the global claim; no finite-field sample is misused as a proof.

value.rationale: The degree-six del Pezzo Togliatti projection is a canonical Laplace-defective toric surface. Precisely determining its integral osculating-rank Fitting scheme exposes a characteristic-two jump from isolated nonreduced flexes (total length 18) to an anticanonical reduced hexagon divisor (degree 6, arithmetic genus 1). The arithmetic failure of flatness and intermediate rank-four boundary stratum are geometric phenomena not supplied by the known characteristic-zero rank table, and they are useful for studying toric jet bundles and mod-p osculatory behavior. This is a motivated structural boundary result, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
